newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rouen Feb 1-26 flour exports 36,996 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Rouen Feb 1-26 flour exports 36,996 tonnes.

text.p: Flour exports from Rouen reached 36,996 tonnes between February 1 and February 26, port officials said on Tuesday.
Flour exports totalled 67,000 tonnes for the whole of February 1996.
February 1-26 exports included 21,774 tonnes for Yemen, 10,122 tonnes for Libya, 5,100 tonnes for West Africa.
One ship was also loading 11,000 tonnes of flour at Rouen, officials said. They said the flour was destined for west Africa and Eritrea.
